definition: the angry feeling you get when you cannot do what you want
sentence: You could hear the {frustration} in her voice on the phone.
translation: По телефону в её голосе слышалось раздражение.

definition: one line of thread made with a needle in cloth or skin
sentence: The cut needed five {stitches} and a week of rest.
translation: На порез наложили пять швов и прописали неделю покоя.

definition: a very large animal that lived millions of years ago
sentence: My son knows the name of every {dinosaur} in the museum.
translation: Мой сын знает названия всех динозавров в музее.

definition: an example of something used for testing or study
sentence: The doctor asked for a blood {specimen} for the test.
translation: Врач попросил образец крови для анализа.

definition: a grey powder mixed with water and sand that becomes hard like stone
sentence: The {cement} has to dry for a day before you walk on it.
translation: Цемент должен сохнуть сутки, прежде чем по нему ходить.

definition: the act of leaving your job on purpose, or quiet acceptance
sentence: She handed in her {resignation} the day after the bonus.
translation: Она подала заявление об уходе на следующий день после премии.

definition: the distance from one side of something to the other
sentence: Measure the {width} of the door before you buy the fridge.
translation: Измерь ширину двери, прежде чем покупать холодильник.

definition: a thin white layer of ice that forms when it is very cold
sentence: There was {frost} on the car windows this morning.
translation: Утром окна машины покрылись инеем.

definition: to build or put up something, in formal language
sentence: They {erected} a huge tent for the wedding in two hours.
translation: Они за два часа поставили огромный шатёр для свадьбы.

definition: a serious promise
sentence: He made a {vow} never to drink again after that party.
translation: После той вечеринки он поклялся больше не пить.

definition: the part of a car that you press with your foot to change gear
sentence: I burned the {clutch} while learning to drive.
translation: Я сжёг сцепление, пока учился водить.

definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird's body
sentence: The pillow is full of {feathers} and very soft.
translation: Подушка набита перьями и очень мягкая.

definition: a unit for measuring electrical power
sentence: A sixty {watt} bulb is too dark for the kitchen.
translation: Лампочка на шестьдесят ватт слишком тусклая для кухни.

definition: a statement that someone has done something wrong
sentence: The {accusation} that I took his pen was ridiculous.
translation: Обвинение в том, что я взял его ручку, было смешным.

definition: the part of a computer that does the calculations
sentence: The new phone has a faster {processor} and a better camera.
translation: У нового телефона быстрее процессор и лучше камера.

definition: to give someone the power or confidence to do something
sentence: Learning to drive {empowered} her to find a better job.
translation: Научившись водить, она смогла найти работу получше.

definition: a form of something that is slightly different from others
sentence: This is a cheaper {variant} of the same phone.
translation: Это более дешёвый вариант того же телефона.

definition: one of the curved bones around your chest
sentence: He broke a {rib} falling off the ladder.
translation: Он сломал ребро, упав с лестницы.

definition: to stop a feeling from showing, or to stop something by force
sentence: I {suppressed} a laugh when he fell into the pool.
translation: Я сдержал смех, когда он свалился в бассейн.

definition: to join several things into one stronger whole
sentence: We {consolidated} three small loans into one.
translation: Мы объединили три небольших кредита в один.

definition: a person who will receive money or property when someone dies
sentence: The old man had no {heir}, so the house went to the city.
translation: У старика не было наследников, и дом отошёл городу.

definition: to become smaller or less important
sentence: My interest in the show {diminished} after the second season.
translation: Мой интерес к сериалу угас после второго сезона.

definition: made of many parts or amounts added together
sentence: The {aggregate} score over the two games was four to three.
translation: Общий счёт по итогам двух игр — четыре три.

definition: a statement that you did something wrong or that you feel something private
sentence: I have a {confession}: I ate your chocolate.
translation: У меня признание: я съел твой шоколад.

definition: to die under water because you cannot breathe
sentence: Two people {drowned} in the river last summer.
translation: Прошлым летом в реке утонули два человека.

definition: the process of getting older
sentence: Good sleep slows down {aging}, or so they say.
translation: Хороший сон замедляет старение, так говорят.

definition: real and true, not a copy
sentence: This is an {authentic} Italian pizza, thin and simple.
translation: Это настоящая итальянская пицца, тонкая и простая.

definition: towards the direction behind you
sentence: He stepped {backwards} and fell into the pool.
translation: Он шагнул назад и упал в бассейн.

definition: to deal with a difficult situation without breaking down
sentence: How do you {cope} with two kids and a full-time job?
translation: Как ты справляешься с двумя детьми и работой на полный день?

definition: strange and making you feel afraid or uncomfortable
sentence: That empty house at the end of the street is {creepy}.
translation: Пустой дом в конце улицы наводит жуть.

definition: in a way connected with feelings
sentence: The last episode was {emotionally} hard to watch.
translation: Последнюю серию было эмоционально тяжело смотреть.

definition: the last part of a show, concert or series
sentence: The {finale} of the series answered every question.
translation: Финал сериала ответил на все вопросы.

definition: lack of knowledge about something
sentence: My {ignorance} of local customs cost me a few awkward moments.
translation: Незнание местных обычаев стоило мне нескольких неловких минут.

definition: in the same way, also
sentence: She shook my hand and I did {likewise}.
translation: Она пожала мне руку, и я сделал то же самое.

definition: very beautiful, grand or impressive
sentence: The view from the castle is {magnificent} in the evening.
translation: Вид из замка вечером великолепен.

definition: connected with numbers and the study of them
sentence: Splitting the bill became a {mathematical} problem for six people.
translation: Делить счёт на шестерых стало математической задачей.

definition: the time between now and a later event
sentence: The pizza comes in an hour, in the {meantime} let's set the table.
translation: Пицца будет через час, а пока давай накроем на стол.

definition: to accept something you do not like without complaining
sentence: I can {tolerate} noise, but not that smell.
translation: Шум я ещё могу терпеть, но не этот запах.

definition: to win or be the strongest in the end
sentence: Common sense {prevailed} and we went home before midnight.
translation: Здравый смысл победил, и мы ушли домой до полуночи.

definition: wanting very much to do or have something
sentence: The kids are {eager} to see the snow.
translation: Дети очень хотят увидеть снег.

definition: not talking much about your own abilities or success
sentence: He's too {modest} to tell you he won the prize.
translation: Он слишком скромен, чтобы сказать, что выиграл приз.

definition: to go away all at once so nobody can see it any more
sentence: My keys {vanished} somewhere between the car and the door.
translation: Мои ключи куда-то пропали между машиной и дверью.

definition: on purpose, not by accident
sentence: She {deliberately} left her phone at home for the weekend.
translation: Она нарочно оставила телефон дома на выходные.

definition: a strong feeling of interest and excitement about something
sentence: I lost my {enthusiasm} for the gym after two weeks.
translation: Через две недели мой запал к спортзалу пропал.

definition: completely, totally
sentence: I was {utterly} exhausted after the move.
translation: После переезда я был совершенно вымотан.

definition: to give money or something good to make up for a loss
sentence: The airline {compensated} us for the lost luggage.
translation: Авиакомпания возместила нам потерянный багаж.

definition: to think or believe something, often a guess
sentence: I {reckon} the train will be late again.
translation: Думаю, поезд снова опоздает.

definition: easy to break or damage, needing careful handling
sentence: Those glasses are {delicate}, so wash them by hand.
translation: Эти бокалы хрупкие, так что мой их вручную.

definition: to hide something so that nobody can see or know it
sentence: She tried to {conceal} her surprise when she saw the bill.
translation: Она попыталась скрыть удивление, когда увидела счёт.

definition: easy to see or understand, obvious
sentence: It's {evident} that he hasn't read the contract.
translation: Очевидно, что он не читал договор.

definition: to give a part of money, time or space for a purpose
sentence: We {allocated} half the budget to the new kitchen.
translation: Половину бюджета мы отвели на новую кухню.

definition: showing good judgement, practical and reasonable
sentence: Taking a taxi at night was the {sensible} choice.
translation: Взять такси ночью было разумным решением.

definition: to admit that something is true after first saying no
sentence: After an hour he {conceded} that I was right about the route.
translation: Через час он признал, что насчёт маршрута я был прав.

definition: to become involved in a situation to change what happens
sentence: The teacher {intervened} before the fight got serious.
translation: Учитель вмешался, пока драка не стала серьёзной.

definition: a meeting of people who have not seen each other for a long time
sentence: Our school {reunion} is in May, are you going?
translation: Встреча выпускников в мае, ты идёшь?

definition: done with great care, looking at every small part
sentence: The mechanic did a {thorough} check of the brakes.
translation: Механик тщательно проверил тормоза.

definition: to move an event to a later time
sentence: Let's {postpone} the picnic until the rain stops.
translation: Давай отложим пикник, пока не закончится дождь.

definition: to keep someone or something inside a limited space or area
sentence: The dog is {confined} to the kitchen while the guests are here.
translation: Пока гости здесь, собака заперта на кухне.
